"""Direct verification of the '|' union-type fix (issue #1874), no pytest.

Builds a real Sphinx app and parses the exact reST from the RFE and the
project's own tests, then inspects the resulting doctree.
"""
import os
import shutil
import tempfile

from docutils import nodes

from sphinx.testing.util import SphinxTestApp
from sphinx.testing.path import path
from sphinx.testing.restructuredtext import parse
from sphinx import addnodes

tmpdir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
try:
    srcdir = path(tmpdir) / 'src'
    os.makedirs(srcdir)
    (srcdir / 'conf.py').write_text('project = "t"\n')
    app = SphinxTestApp(srcdir=srcdir)

    # --- RFE example: :type text: bytes | str on a function param ---
    text = (".. py:function:: foo(text)\n"
            "   :param text: a text\n"
            "   :type text: bytes | str\n")
    doctree = parse(app, text)
    # find the param field body paragraph
    field = doctree.traverse(nodes.field)
    assert field, "no field produced"
    body = field[0].traverse(nodes.paragraph)[0]
    texts = [n.astext() for n in body.children]
    print('param field paragraph:', texts)
    xrefs = [n for n in body.traverse(addnodes.pending_xref)]
    targets = [x['reftarget'] for x in xrefs]
    print('pending_xref targets:', targets)
    assert targets == ['bytes', 'str'], targets
    # the '|' must remain as plain text between the two xrefs
    plain = [n.astext() for n in body.children
             if isinstance(n, nodes.Text) and n.astext().strip() == '|']
    assert plain, "pipe separator lost"
    print('pipe separator present: OK')

    # --- the project's own test: py:function signature annotation ---
    text2 = ".. py:function:: hello(age: int | None)"
    dt2 = parse(app, text2)
    params = dt2.traverse(addnodes.desc_parameter)
    sig_texts = [n.astext() for n in params[0].children]
    print('signature param:', sig_texts)
    sig_xrefs = [x['reftarget'] for x in params[0].traverse(addnodes.pending_xref)]
    print('signature xref targets:', sig_xrefs)
    assert sig_xrefs == ['int', 'None'], sig_xrefs

    # --- the project's own test: py:data :type: int | str ---
    text3 = (".. py:data:: version\n"
             "   :type: int | str\n")
    dt3 = parse(app, text3)
    ann = dt3.traverse(addnodes.desc_annotation)
    ann_xrefs = [x['reftarget'] for x in ann[0].traverse(addnodes.pending_xref)]
    print('py:data :type: xref targets:', ann_xrefs)
    assert ann_xrefs == ['int', 'str'], ann_xrefs

    # --- regression: old 'or' syntax and plain types still work ---
    dt4 = parse(app, ".. py:data:: v2\n   :type: int or str\n")
    ann4 = dt4.traverse(addnodes.desc_annotation)
    ann4_xrefs = [x['reftarget'] for x in ann4[0].traverse(addnodes.pending_xref)]
    print("'int or str' xref targets:", ann4_xrefs)
    assert ann4_xrefs == ['int', 'str'], ann4_xrefs

    dt5 = parse(app, ".. py:data:: v3\n   :type: int\n")
    ann5 = dt5.traverse(addnodes.desc_annotation)
    ann5_xrefs = [x['reftarget'] for x in ann5[0].traverse(addnodes.pending_xref)]
    print("'int' xref targets:", ann5_xrefs)
    assert ann5_xrefs == ['int'], ann5_xrefs

    print('ALL DIRECT CHECKS PASSED')
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(tmpdir, ignore_errors=True)
